name: BottomSheet
title: BottomSheet
summary: A panel that slides up from the bottom of an app screen for sharing and quick options, plus the iOS-style action sheet for a short list of commands with Cancel.
whenToUse: Use the bottom sheet for a focused task tied to what is on screen: share a verse, pick a translation, write to an NFC card.
Use the peek height for a few options; let people drag to expanded (96px from the top) for more.
Use the action sheet for 2–5 commands on one item (a highlight, a note), especially when one is destructive.
whenNotToUse: Do not use a sheet for long forms or reading; push a new screen.

anatomy.description: Scrim + sheet. Grab handle, header with a 36px close button, then content. Action sheet:

props.name: variant
props.description: `sheet` is the panel with a grab handle and Close; `action` is the iOS-style command list with Cancel.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the sheet asks to open or close (Esc, scrim, drag down, Close, Cancel, after an action).

props.name: title
props.description: Title that says the task, e.g. "Share this verse". Receives focus on open.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Sheet: sub-line naming the source, e.g. "John 3:16 · Berean Standard Bible". Action: the line under the bold title.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Sheet: expanded height (top 96px) with the stronger 42% scrim. The peek has a 28% scrim.

props.name: shareOptions
props.description: Sheet: share tiles shown in a four-column row under the sub-line.

props.name: actions
props.description: Action sheet: commands, destructive last.

props.name: children
props.description: Sheet: extra content under the share row, such as `.ap-verse` or `.ap-sheet-list` rows. Also the action sheet's extra content.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the Close button.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Action sheet: Cancel text. Cancel is never red.

props.name: modal
props.description: Mark the dialog `aria-modal` and trap focus.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show the sheet. It animates in and out; unmounts after the exit.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called by the scrim, the Close button and a drag down. The sheet only hides when you set `visible` to false.

props.name: title
props.description: Task title: "Share this verse". Gets focus when the sheet opens.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Source line under the title: "John 3:16 · Berean Standard Bible".

props.name: children
props.description: Sheet content: share tiles, list rows, a verse preview.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Expanded height (top 96dp, heavier scrim) instead of the content-height peek. Controlled.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the reader drags up (to expand).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the Close button.

props.name: safeAreaInsets
props.description: Safe-area insets; `bottom` is added under the content.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Sheet: white, `--radius-xl` top corners, grab handle 40×5 `--gray-300`.
Share options are 56px tiles in `--blue-tint` with Horizon Blue icons, four per row.
Rows that open another screen end with ›; rows that act immediately have no trailing icon.
Action sheet: inset 10px, `--radius-lg` cards, `--shadow-overlay`. Cancel sits in its own card in Horizon Blue 600.
Only one destructive row, last in the group. Never make Cancel red.
Tapping the scrim or dragging down closes the sheet; the close X does the same.
All rows are at least 52px (action rows 56px).

accessibility: `role="dialog"` with `aria-labelledby` on the title; expanded sheets and action sheets are `aria-modal="true"` and trap focus.
Move focus to the sheet title on open and back to the trigger on close. Escape closes.
The grab handle is decorative; always offer the visible Close button or Cancel.
Respect reduced motion: fade instead of slide.
content: Titles say the task: "Share this verse". Sub-line names the source: "John 3:16 · Berean Standard Bible".
Commands are verb first: "Copy verse", "Add a note", "Remove highlight".
